title: S&P 500 is little changed to start the week; Micron leads tech lower: Live updates
summary: The S&P 500 is flat at the start of the week as investors prepare for major bank earnings reports and upcoming inflation data. Tech stocks are declining with Micron leading losses. Market sentiment hinges on these key economic indicators and corporate earnings results.
content: Investors are looking ahead to a busy week of earnings results from the big banks and inflation data.

zh.title: 标普500指数开盘基本持平；美光领跌科技股：实时更新
zh.summary: 标普500指数在一周开始时基本持平，投资者为主要银行财报和即将公布的通胀数据做准备。科技股下跌，美光领跌。市场情绪取决于这些关键经济指标和企业盈利结果。

title: DOJ confirms search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home in federal investigation
summary: The Department of Justice confirmed it conducted a search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's home as part of a federal investigation. Omar, a Minnesota Democrat and Muslim born in Somalia, has previously faced criticism from political opponents. Investigation details remain unclear from available reporting.
content: The Minnesota Democrat, a Muslim who was born in Somalia, has been targeted for criticism in the past by President Donald Trump.

zh.title: 美司法部确认搜查众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔的住所
zh.summary: 美国司法部确认在联邦调查过程中搜查了众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔的住所。奥马尔是明尼苏达州民主党人和出生于索马里的穆斯林，曾面临政治对手的批评。根据现有报告，调查的详细信息仍不清楚。

title: FAA warns U.S. airlines of safety risks over Saudi Arabia after attacks
summary: The FAA issued a warning to U.S. airlines regarding safety risks over Saudi Arabian airspace following recent attacks on Riyadh airport. The warning has disrupted travel plans, with Delta reconsidering its October 23 launch date. The security concerns reflect broader regional tensions affecting commercial aviation.
content: The FAA warned U.S. airlines about flight risks over Saudi Arabia as Riyadh airport attacks disrupt travel and Delta weighs an Oct. 23 launch.

zh.title: FAA警告美国航空公司沙特阿拉伯上空存在安全风险
zh.summary: 美国联邦航空局在利雅得机场遭近期袭击后，向美国航空公司发出了关于沙特阿拉伯领空安全风险的警告。该警告已打乱旅行计划，达美航空正重新考虑其10月23日的首航日期。安全问题反映了影响民航运输的更广泛的地区紧张局势。

title: Starbucks says it is not buying Chipotle after takeover speculation
summary: Starbucks denied speculation that it plans to acquire Chipotle, with a company spokesperson explicitly stating the company is not pursuing such a deal. The denial comes as investors speculated about potential strategic consolidation in the fast-casual restaurant sector. The clarification ends discussion of a possible major merger in the quick-service restaurant industry.
content: "Starbucks is not buying Chipotle," a Starbucks spokesperson told CNBC.

zh.title: 星巴克否认收购Chipotle的传言
zh.summary: 星巴克否认了有关其计划收购Chipotle的传言，公司发言人明确表示该公司没有追求这样的交易。这一否认是在投资者推测快休闲餐饮行业可能进行战略整合之际提出的。这一澄清终结了关于快餐行业可能发生重大并购的讨论。

title: Zelenskyy accuses Russia of violating Trump’s energy ceasefire as drone attacks continue
summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy accused Russia of violating an energy ceasefire proposal from President Trump while drone attacks continue. Zelenskyy warned that Ukraine will respond if Russia does not honor the ceasefire agreement. The escalation suggests ongoing military tensions despite diplomatic peace initiatives.
content: If Russia doesn't agree to Trump's energy ceasefire, Ukraine will respond, Zelenskyy said Monday morning.

zh.title: 泽连斯基指控俄罗斯违反特朗普能源停火协议，无人机攻击持续
zh.summary: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基指控俄罗斯违反了特朗普总统提出的能源停火提议，同时无人机攻击持续进行。泽连斯基警告，如果俄罗斯不遵守停火协议，乌克兰将做出回应。升级局势表明尽管有外交和平倡议，军事紧张局势仍在继续。

title: Microsoft hits a big milestone that solidifies its revival
summary: Microsoft achieved a $4 trillion market capitalization in intraday trading on Monday, marking a significant milestone in the company's valuation resurgence. The achievement reflects continued investor confidence in the company's AI initiatives and business performance. Analysts suggest additional market cap records may be ahead.
content: Microsoft has reclaimed a $4 trillion market cap in intraday action Monday — and fresh records are in sight.

zh.title: 微软达到重要里程碑，巩固其复兴势头
zh.summary: 微软在周一的盘中交易中达到了4万亿美元的市值，标志着该公司估值复苏中的重要里程碑。这一成就反映了投资者对该公司人工智能举措和业务表现的持续信心。分析师表示可能还会有更多的市值记录。

title: Buy the dip on this satellite stock as catalysts line up, says Deutsche Bank
summary: Deutsche Bank upgraded a satellite company stock from hold to buy, maintaining a $93 price target and suggesting investors should buy recent dips. The upgrade reflects confidence in upcoming catalysts that could drive the stock higher. The recommendation reflects emerging opportunities in the satellite sector.
content: The bank upgraded the stock to buy from hold and maintained its $93 price target.

zh.title: 德意志银行表示，随着催化剂逐步出现，应该买入这只卫星股票的低点
zh.summary: 德意志银行将一家卫星公司股票从持有升级为买入，维持93美元的目标价，建议投资者逢低买入。此次升级反映了对即将到来的催化剂的信心，这些催化剂可能会推高股价。该建议反映了卫星产业新兴的机会。

title: Nobel prize in economics awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
summary: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford, U.S. economists, received the Nobel Prize in Economics for their foundational work on models used by central banks and governments for economic stabilization. Their research has shaped macroeconomic policy frameworks globally. The award recognizes critical contributions to modern economic management.
content: The U.S. economists were awarded for work that underpins the models used by central banks and governments to stabilize the economy.

zh.title: 诺贝尔经济学奖授予罗伯特·霍尔和迈克尔·伍德福德
zh.summary: 美国经济学家罗伯特·霍尔和迈克尔·伍德福德因其在中央银行和政府经济稳定模型基础工作上的贡献获得诺贝尔经济学奖。他们的研究塑造了全球宏观经济政策框架。该奖项承认了他们对现代经济管理的重要贡献。

title: Microsoft to rely more on homegrown AI chips, reducing dependence on Nvidia
summary: Microsoft is shifting toward developing and using its own AI chips, reducing reliance on Nvidia processors. This strategy aims to improve profit margins and strengthen Microsoft's competitive position in artificial intelligence. The move reflects broader industry trends toward vertical integration and semiconductor self-sufficiency.
content: By increasingly counting on its own chips, Microsoft stands to expand margins and bolster its AI stack.

zh.title: 微软增加对自研AI芯片的依赖，减少对英伟达的依赖
zh.summary: 微软正在转向开发和使用自己的AI芯片，减少对英伟达处理器的依赖。该战略旨在改善利润率并加强微软在人工智能领域的竞争地位。此举反映了业界朝向垂直整合和半导体自给自足的更广泛趋势。

title: Winter heating costs are expected to be 8.3% higher than last year. But could El Niño help?
summary: Winter heating costs are projected to increase 8.3% compared to last year, adding to household budget pressures across America. The analysis suggests El Niño weather patterns could potentially moderate these rising costs. Expensive utility bills remain a significant concern for American consumers facing financial strain.
content: Expensive utility bills have become an increasingly sharp thorn for Americans’ wallets.

zh.title: 冬季供暖成本预计比去年高8.3%。但厄尔尼诺现象能帮助吗?
zh.summary: 冬季供暖成本预计将比去年增加8.3%，加重美国各地家庭的预算压力。分析表明厄尔尼诺天气模式可能会缓和这些上升的成本。昂贵的公用事业账单仍然是面临财务困难的美国消费者的主要关切。

title: Banks are set to report this week. Here's what the options market expects
summary: Major banks are preparing to report earnings this week, with options markets pricing in significant volatility for the financial sector. Despite the broader market remaining flat year-to-date, investors are bracing for substantial moves as they assess the impact of higher interest rates on bank profitability. The derivatives market suggests heightened expectations for bank sector performance.
content: Despite being flat on the year, the options market is pricing in some big financial sector moves as investor weigh the impact of higher rates.

zh.title: 银行本周将公布财报。期权市场预期什么?
zh.summary: 主要银行本周准备公布财报，期权市场对金融部门定价了显著的波动性。尽管更广泛的市场年初至今保持平坦，投资者正在准备面对重大变动，因为他们评估更高利率对银行盈利能力的影响。衍生品市场表明对银行部门业绩有高度的期望。

title: ‘The prospectus looks impressive’: My financial adviser wants me to invest $350,000 in a UAE data center. Is this risky?
summary: A recently retired investor in their 60s is considering a $350,000 investment in a UAE data center project based on an adviser's recommendation and impressive prospectus. The investor seeks risk assessment before committing funds. The question highlights concerns about concentrated investments and geographic diversification for retirees.
content: “I’m in my 60s, recently retired and living my best life.”

zh.title: "招股说明书看起来很吸引人"：我的财务顾问想让我投资35万美元在阿联酋数据中心。这风险大吗?
zh.summary: 一位年近60岁的新退休投资者正在考虑根据顾问建议和令人印象深刻的招股说明书，向阿联酋数据中心项目投资35万美元。投资者在承诺资金前寻求风险评估。这个问题突出了对退休人士集中投资和地理多元化的关注。

title: ‘I have no children’: My aunt gave me $50,000 for a down payment. Now she wants me to leave my home to her two children.
summary: A homeowner who received $50,000 from their aunt toward a $385,000 home purchase now faces a request to will the property to the aunt's two children. The situation raises complex family and legal considerations regarding conditional gifts and estate planning. The case illustrates potential conflicts between family expectations and property ownership rights.
content: “The house cost $385,000. With my savings, her $50,000 and a small mortgage, I was able to close.”

zh.title: "我没有孩子"：我的阿姨给了我5万美元作为首付。现在她想让我把房子留给她的两个孩子。
zh.summary: 一位房主从阿姨那里获得5万美元作为38.5万美元房屋购买的首付，现在面临将该房产遗赠给阿姨两个孩子的要求。这种情况引发了有关条件性礼物和遗产规划的复杂家庭和法律考虑。这个案例说明了家庭期望和房产所有权之间可能存在的冲突。

title: This five-star money manager shares three stock picks, including one betting on dying American malls
summary: A highly-rated money manager has shared three stock recommendations, including a contrarian pick betting on the struggling American mall sector. The recommendations include two lesser-known companies unfamiliar to many U.S. investors. The picks reflect both defensive and opportunistic strategies in the current market environment.
content: One highly rated fund manager shares some top picks, including two names many U.S. investors will be unfamiliar with.

zh.title: 这位五星级基金经理分享三只股票选择，其中包括一只押注衰落的美国购物中心的股票
zh.summary: 一位备受好评的基金经理分享了三项股票建议，其中包括一只对挣扎中的美国购物中心部门进行逆势押注的选择。这些建议包括两家许多美国投资者不熟悉的鲜为人知的公司。这些选择反映了当前市场环境中既防守性又机会主义的策略。

title: AI minister warns 'likely' UK's cyber defences will be breached
summary: The UK's AI minister warned that the nation's cyber defenses will "likely" be breached, highlighting vulnerability to sophisticated attacks. The government is investing in advanced AI technology to strengthen its cybersecurity posture and resilience. The statement underscores growing concerns about the UK's preparedness for cyber threats.
content: Kanishka Narayan said the government will use advanced AI to strengthen the UK against cyber attacks.

zh.title: 人工智能部长警告"可能"英国的网络防御将被突破
zh.summary: 英国人工智能部长警告称该国的网络防御"可能"会被突破，凸显了对复杂攻击的脆弱性。政府正在投资先进的人工智能技术来加强其网络安全态势和韧性。该声明强调了人们对英国网络威胁防范能力的日益担忧。

title: TikTok CEO sees major scientific breakthroughs from AI within three years
summary: TikTok CEO predicts major scientific breakthroughs from AI within three years, but emphasizes the need for stronger safeguards as autonomous systems become more widespread. This reflects growing industry concerns about balancing AI innovation with regulatory oversight.
content: Chew cautioned that AI's growing capabilities would require stronger safeguards, particularly as autonomous systems become more widely adopted.

zh.title: TikTok首席执行官预测三年内AI将实现重大科学突破
zh.summary: TikTok首席执行官预测AI在三年内将实现重大科学突破，但强调随着自主系统的广泛应用，需要加强安全保障。这反映了业界对平衡AI创新与监管监督的日益关注。

title: Oil falls after Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
summary: Oil prices fell following Trump's declaration of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy expressing support for the measure. This ceasefire could have significant implications for global energy markets and the ongoing conflict.
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a post on social media that "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well."

zh.title: 特朗普宣布俄乌能源休战后油价下跌
zh.summary: 在特朗普宣布俄乌能源休战后油价下跌，乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示支持该措施。这一休战可能会对全球能源市场和正在进行的冲突产生重大影响。

title: Judge orders Trump administration to immediately stop taxpayer-funded TV ads
summary: A judge has ordered the Trump administration to halt taxpayer-funded TV advertisements, citing concerns that the ads constitute government propaganda and were designed to influence midterm election outcomes. The ruling underscores ongoing legal challenges to the administration's use of government resources for political purposes.
content: The ads featuring President Trump have been criticized as government propaganda and as aimed at influencing the outcome of the midterm election.

zh.title: 法官命令特朗普政府立即停止由纳税人资助的电视广告
zh.summary: 法官已责令特朗普政府停止由纳税人资助的电视广告，理由是这些广告构成政府宣传，旨在影响中期选举结果。该裁决强调了对政府将公共资源用于政治目的的持续法律挑战。

title: Why China is importing a record amount of gold — and what it means for prices
summary: China's record gold imports reflect the government's efforts to reduce dollar dependence and Chinese households' demand for safe-haven assets. This surge in demand could significantly impact global gold prices and China's foreign exchange strategy.
content: Beijing’s push to diversify away from the dollar and Chinese households’ search for a safe place to put their savings has fueled China’s record gold buying.

zh.title: 中国为何进口创纪录数量的黄金——这对价格意味着什么
zh.summary: 中国创纪录的黄金进口反映了政府减少美元依赖的努力以及中国家庭对安全资产的需求。这种需求的激增可能会对全球黄金价格和中国的外汇战略产生重大影响。

title: Plenty is working against this market. Here's why I'm staying invested anyway
summary: Despite unfavorable market conditions, an investor argues for maintaining stock exposure rather than exiting the market. The article explores why staying invested may still be prudent despite near-term headwinds.
content: The fact is, I don't have a strong case for owning stocks at the moment.

zh.title: 许多因素对这个市场不利。这是我仍然坚持投资的原因
zh.summary: 尽管市场条件不利，一位投资者主张维持股票敞口而不是退出市场。文章探讨了为什么尽管短期逆风，坚持投资可能仍然是明智的。
